name: Pumpkin Night
css:
/* Pumpkin Night: a misty pumpkin patch under a full moon (original illustration). The jack-o'-lanterns always sit in the free strip right of the conversation, sized to fit it, and glow brighter while the agent works; a candle wick under the composer burns down as the context fills. Dark only. */
 :root{--t3-radius-composer: 18px;--t3-radius-bubble: 16px;--t3-radius-card: 12px;--t3-radius-control: 8px;--t3-composer-outline: rgb(255 150 50 / 0.6);--t3-composer-shadow: none;--pn-orange: max(330px,calc((var(--pn-g) - 22px) / 0.372));--pn-ih: calc(var(--pn-iw) * 0.5625)}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]{isolation: isolate;accent-color: var(--pn-orange);background: radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 30px 40px,#fff9 50%,transparent),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 120px 90px,#fff8 50%,transparent),radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 20px,#ffe9b8aa 50%,transparent),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 260px 150px,#fff7 50%,transparent),radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 80px 190px,#fff6 50%,transparent),linear-gradient(180deg,#0f0b24 0%,#19143a 55%,#2a2450 100%);background-size: 317px 233px,211px 179px,431px 307px,263px 191px,373px 281px,auto}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::before{content: "";position: fixed;z-index: -1;right: calc(6px - 0.043 * var(--pn-iw));bottom: 0;width: var(--pn-iw);height: var(--pn-ih);background: var(--t3-asset-art) center / 100% 100% no-repeat;-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 32%),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 30%);mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 32%),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 30%);-webkit-mask-composite: source-in;mask-composite: intersect;pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::after{content: "";position: fixed;z-index: -1;right: calc(8px + 0.02 * var(--pn-iw));bottom: calc(0.12 * var(--pn-ih));width: calc(0.4 * var(--pn-iw));height: calc(0.4
